function.zh-Hans: 让相关功能更容易进入流通、承接或可用状态

boundary.en: It does not guarantee money, profit or a desired outcome.

boundary.en: It does not guarantee promotion, authority or dominance.

boundary.zh-Hans: 不等于必然成名、获奖或得到认可。
